modules.name: Clarity
modules.description: User interface clarity: a patch you can read at a glance. Every jack tells you what it is without reading the panel — colour for the kind of signal, and a ring that says input or output, the same on every module, whoever wrote it. Cables take the colour of where they go, with dashes crawling along them, so there is never a moment wondering which way a signal is flowing. Trace one cable through a tangle, pinch to zoom, and pick cables up with a click. Each of these is a switch on the panel, so what it does is what you can see.

modules.name: Test Gear
modules.description: Test gear for your rack. Right-click any terminal and clip an instrument onto it: an oscilloscope, a frequency analyser that reads the peak as a note, or an audio monitor that lets you listen to that point through one output jack. There are sources too — gate, pulse, clock, DC, LFO, VCO, note, volt per octave, noise and an attenuverter — and they work on a terminal that already has a cable in it. Everything you attach is saved with the patch.
